description:
Mini anime of Shuumatsu Train Doko e Iku? posted on the KADOKAWA Anime YouTube channel.

Shizuru, Nadeshiko, Remi, and Akira are affected by 7G!? They've transformed into a Wan Wan Train! I wonder if everyone can get along...?
